verdict.rationale: Fellow's official MCP server lets users ask an AI assistant such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor natural-language questions about their meetings, such as "What were my action items this week?", with no code required. A built-in "Ask Fellow" feature is also listed on the pricing page. The documented natural-language use is mostly querying, not operating the product: the write operations (editing agendas, completing action items) are documented only as REST endpoints, not as natural-language or MCP actions. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can perform actions (create or edit notes, complete action items, control recording), detail on what Ask Fellow does, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
